sources.entry: ProfilesManager - Apple iOS/macOS Provisioning Profiles management,.provisionprofile, .mobileprovision files manager tool for mac.

summary.one_liner: ProfilesManager is a macOS app for viewing, installing, exporting and managing iOS/macOS provisioning profiles (.mobileprovision and .provisionprofile files).
summary.what_it_does: The app shows all provisioning profiles on the Mac in a tree view and supports full-text search filtering. Profiles can be installed by dragging them in, and right-click menus offer show in Finder, export, move to trash, and renaming the file to its descriptive name instead of the UUID. It can export developer certificates from a profile as .cer files. Dragging an .ipa or plist into the window shows the embedded profile or Info.plist. Version 2.3 adds a one-key install or uninstall of a Quick Look plug-in so that .ipa, .xcarchive, .appex, .mobileprovision and .provisionprofile files can be previewed with the spacebar. The README also includes a reference section describing the fields of a provisioning profile, such as TeamName, AppIDName, DeveloperCertificates, entitlements and ProvisionedDevices.
use_cases: browse installed iOS provisioning profiles on a Mac
find and delete old provisioning profiles
export developer certificates from a profile
preview .ipa or .xcarchive files with Quick Look
look up what fields a provisioning profile contains
how_to_run: Download the app from the Download APP section of the README (no link is given in the text).
stack: Objective-C/Swift macOS app (not specified in README)
notable: Tree view of all profiles on the Mac, with multi-select and column sorting
Right-click renames UUID-named profile files to match the App Store profile name
One-key install or uninstall of a Quick Look plug-in for Apple developer file types
Drag .ipa or plist files in to inspect embedded profiles and Info.plist
README includes a reference on the structure of provisioning profiles
caveats: README gives no build or install steps and the Download APP section is empty
Mac-only tool; the README describes it as a tool for mac
